v12_tolerated_expected.description: The reported case. An idempotent reset that clears nothing must be tolerated and the bundle must continue to its end mark. Seeds an effect and clears it first, so the declared command reliably meets the empty case regardless of what the player already had. An earlier version used a bare clear as that setup and halted on it, which is the exact failure this feature exists to remove.

v12_tolerated_is_narrow.description: The control that matters. The same command declares a tolerated key, then fails for a different reason. It must still halt, proving a declaration does not tolerate everything.

v12_undeclared_still_halts.description: The same empty reset with no declaration must still halt, proving the default is unchanged for every bundle written before this feature.
